blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Government lawyers have asked the Supreme Court to clarify which projects in the unprogrammed appropriations under the 2024 and 2025 national budgets may continue despite the Court declaring such funding unconstitutional. The Office of the Solicitor General (OSG) filed an 85-page motion for clarification and partial reconsideration on Nov. 4 to the decision of the high court last month striking the unprogrammed funds as illegal in the national budgets under the Marcos administration. Led by Solicitor General Darlene Berberabe, the state lawyers are urging the high tribunal to clarify that unprogrammed appropriations are not entirely unconstitutional for the […]...
